question: Where is the Qutub Minar situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Qutub Minar** is located in **Delhi**, India.
 
• It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the tallest minarets in the world, standing at a height of 73 meters.
 
• The construction of the Qutub Minar was initiated by **Qutb-ud-din Aibak** in 1192 and was completed by his successor, Iltutmish<
